label: public API list prices, USD per million tokens
note: Replaceable data file: keys are bare model ids (provider prefix stripped). cache_write_5m and cache_write_1h are the two write prices; the bench records do not say which one a write used. Sonnet 5.5 cache reads halved on 2026-10-07 (announcement; the pricing page lagged). Haiku 5.5 is priced per prompt length: the row is the <= 100k-token tier and `long_context` (above: prompt tokens = input + cache_read + cache_write of one request) is the tier above it, 5x on every field; the cost code applies it per request when the usage log is available, else flat with tier_approx. Pricing page 2026-10-09: Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 have no long-context tier (page: "Claude 4.6 and later models (except Claude Haiku 5.5) ... include the full 1M token context window at standard pricing"), so they carry no long_context entry.
